name: Duck Eggs
siboNotes: Duck eggs are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Their higher fat content may slow gastric emptying, which can be beneficial for some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Cook thoroughly due to slightly higher risk of salmonella compared to chicken eggs
Use lower heat and longer cooking time as duck eggs have thicker shells and larger yolks
Great for baking due to higher fat and protein content
Store in refrigerator and use within 2-3 weeks of purchase
nutritionalHighlights: Higher in protein than chicken eggs (9g vs 6g per egg)
Rich in vitamin B12 and selenium
Good source of choline for brain health
Higher in healthy fats, particularly omega-3 fatty acids
